script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS myt_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       j.causation_id AS packing_id,
       (SELECT p.packing_lock_session_id
          FROM packing p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.id = CAST(j.causation_id AS UNSIGNED)) AS lock_session,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at,
       (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_KCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT CAST(st.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       st.step_name,
       st.step_status,
       st.attempt_count,
       st.inventory_operation_id
  FROM gd_publish_step st
 WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.jobId}}'
   AND st.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT CAST(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) AS CHAR) AS valid,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.job_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_job,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.packing_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_packing,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.packing_no')) END AS CHAR) AS p_packing_no,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.gd_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_gd,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.delivery_no')) END AS CHAR) AS p_delivery_no,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.plant_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_plant,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.organization_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_org,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.requested_by')) END AS CHAR) AS p_requested_by,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.correlation_id')) END AS CHAR) AS p_correlation,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_LENGTH(j.prepared_payload, '$.gd_lines') END AS CHAR) AS n_lines,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_LENGTH(j.prepared_payload, '$.res_updates') END AS CHAR) AS n_upd,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_LENGTH(j.prepared_payload, '$.res_creates') END AS CHAR) AS n_new,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_LENGTH(j.prepared_payload, '$.effects') END AS CHAR) AS n_eff,
       CAST(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload) THEN JSON_LENGTH(j.prepared_payload, '$.missing') END AS CHAR) AS n_missing
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_KCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST('LINE' AS CHAR) AS kind,
       CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(CRC32(COALESCE(l.temp_qty_data, '')) AS CHAR) AS v1,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS v2,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS v3,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS v4,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS v5,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS v6
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.snap.lines'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (lid BIGINT PATH '$[0]')) x
  JOIN goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
    ON l.id = x.lid
   AND l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_KCguard.data.jobId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('RES' AS CHAR), CAST(r.id AS CHAR), CAST(r.reserved_qty AS CHAR), CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR), CAST(r.status AS CHAR), CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR),
       CAST(r.handling_unit_id AS CHAR), CAST(r.is_deleted AS CHAR)
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.snap.res'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (rid BIGINT PATH '$[0]')) x
  JOIN on_reserved_gd r
    ON r.id = x.rid
   AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_KCguard.data.jobId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('GD' AS CHAR), CAST(g.id AS CHAR), CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(g.is_deleted AS CHAR)
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_KCentry.data.gdId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('PACK' AS CHAR), CAST(p.id AS CHAR), CAST(p.packing_status AS CHAR), CAST(p.packing_lock_session_id AS CHAR),
       (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR)
          FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
         WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KCentry.data.packingId}}
           AND h.is_deleted = 0),
       (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CRC32(CONCAT_WS('|', h.id, COALESCE(h.hu_status, ''), COALESCE(h.temp_data, ''), COALESCE(h.handling_unit_id, ''), COALESCE(h.location_id, '')))), 0) AS CHAR)
          FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
         WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KCentry.data.packingId}}
           AND h.is_deleted = 0),
       CAST(COALESCE(p.packing_lock_expires_at > CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), 0) AS CHAR), CAST(p.is_deleted AS CHAR)
  FROM packing p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.id = {{node:code_node_KCentry.data.packingId}}
